description: Render Markdown, HTML, a public URL, or a Handlebars template with data into a PDF or PNG file. Exactly one of markdown, html, url, or template is required. Returns the local path of the written output file (response_mode: path, default) or the file as base64 (response_mode: base64).

filename.description: Base name for the output file, without extension

paper.description: Paper size, e.g. A4, Letter (default A4)

response_mode.description: How to return the file (default path)

name: render
title: Render to PDF or PNG
